---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea for tokenflare
title: "[feat] "
labels: enhancement
body:
  - type: textarea
    id: problem
    attributes:
      label: What problem does this solve?
      description: Describe what you're trying to accomplish. "I want to see X because..."
    validations:
      required: true
  - type: textarea
    id: solution
    attributes:
      label: What would you like to see?
      description: Describe the solution you'd like. Screenshots or mockups welcome.
    validations:
      required: true
  - type: textarea
    id: alternatives
    attributes:
      label: Alternatives considered
      description: What other ways have you tried or considered?
---

<!-- tokenflare favors small, focused features that fit the observe-only / fail-open design. See CONTRIBUTING.md. -->
